gen.title: Balanced and Unbalanced Forces in Simplified Flight

cards.stem: Which pairing keeps an aircraft at steady level speed when forces stay even?
options: the weight would be balanced by the lift
lift would be balanced by drag
weight would be balanced by thrust
thrust would be balanced by weight
cards.quote: the weight would be balanced by the lift and the drag would be balanced by the thrust
cards.hint: Think about which vertical and horizontal pairs cancel.

cards.stem: What happens when upward force exceeds downward force while other forces stay steady?
options: level flight continues with no change
cards.hint: Focus on the vertical pair alone.

cards.stem: What result follows when downward force is greater than upward force?
cards.hint: Consider the same vertical forces in reverse.

cards.stem: Which inequality describes gaining speed when forward push grows while resistance stays steady?
cards.hint: Look at the horizontal force pair.
